notes: Audit completed 2026-09-21 against primary relationship and product sources. Publish these nine entries as Research candidates only, never as referrals received. First Voyage must retain its adjacent consumer-fit label.

Wayline has direct portfolio-alumni evidence and B2B vertical-AI relevance. Meshi and MoltPod have organizational AI workflows plus organizer-confirmed pitch interactions. ARVAM has a verified pitch interaction and B2B EAM product, but AI capability and venture-scale fit are unverified.

Meshi, MoltPod and ARVAM come from one organizer-published session recap. This establishes actual pitch and feedback interactions, not positive sentiment, ongoing mentorship, investment, willingness to introduce or consent. These are historical events, not evidence that Rao is a current active referrer.

First Voyage has a strong founder-disclosed Tanay Kothari angel connection. It remains separately marked adjacent consumer fit because no enterprise offering was established. Its inclusion is useful as an evidenced founder-network route, not a claim of core B2B mandate fit.

Glen, Lab0 and Avora were added on 2026-09-21 from an exhaustive sweep of Y Combinator founder biographies across batches W22 to S26 (2,959 company pages). Each names a Together portfolio company as the founder's prior employer on the new company's own YC page. These are employer-alumnus links, not investments, advisory roles or endorsements.

Glen's case carries an extra caution: Composio is Glen's paying design-partner customer, so any approach touches a live commercial relationship. Ask the portfolio founder before contacting the company.

The YC sweep is exhaustive only for YC-backed alumni founders. Alumni who founded companies outside YC — likely across Kula, Zipy, RevenueHero, Spendflo, Togai, Securden, Bytebeam and DhiWise — were not reachable in that pass and remain unsearched. No qualifying Togai alumnus was found.

Factors.ai was removed: Nivas publicly endorsed the product, but no primary evidence established a personal connection to a named Factors founder. Sharing an event agenda on separate panels is insufficient.

Together portfolio page text extraction exposes an Exited label across several pages, including Wispr Flow. This may be hidden template text; do not infer current portfolio exit status from these extracts. Portfolio founder identity is verified independently of that label.

No private email address, relationship score, NPS, fundraising intent or consent was inferred. Exact publication/event dates were omitted where sources exposed only inconsistent relative labels. Self-reported product and customer claims need diligence.

The final bounded replacement pass found no additional active-portfolio B2B relationship with sufficient primary evidence. OSSO has an explicit Brijraj Bhuptani investor link, but clinics/care delivery is outside the software focus and was excluded. Rajiv Ramanan connections to CultureMonkey and Paybee appeared only in accessible third-party profiles and were not added.
Bohocap.ai adds a named advisor connection through Vishalini Paliwal. Verify current advisory involvement and software-product fit before asking for an introduction.

excludedAfterAudit.reason: No verified introduction path. A real historical product endorsement does not establish that Nivas knows Praveen or another Factors founder. G2 lists them at the same event on separate panels, which does not establish contact.
